source: Fiverr profile fiverr.com/creators1 (public reviews), supplied by Talha on 1 October 2026
rules: Every review is shown with the label 'on Fiverr' and the client's Fiverr username and country.

Words are verbatim, including the clients' own spelling. Only typography was normalised: curly quotes to straight, dashes to colons or full stops (see note fields), trailing 'See more' and 'See less' removed.
is_excerpt = true means the quote ends early at a full sentence. Never cut mid-sentence.
Project prices are deliberately left out. Fiverr prices anchor too low for agency work.
period_label: show it when it is a month and year. Hide it when it reads 'Over a year ago'.
Clients often call Talha 'Max' (from Maxterz). The About page should explain this in one line.
No Review or AggregateRating schema for these (D11).

excluded.reasons: adri17341, aubrey56451 (x2), danambrosio89 and dfvisd use emojis and shouting capitals; asajosiah calls the video itself 'average'.
